description: Soft-delete a 3PL client by id (reversible in the DB; the client stops appearing in listings and recommendations). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token on a 3PL tenant.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured cascade/impact preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is deleted until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: delete_client
title: Delete Client
